info.title: MeeSell svc-iam
info.description: Standalone identity / OTP / token-issuance microservice (MS Sub-Plan G)

post.summary: Send a 6-digit OTP to a phone number
post.description: §7.B.1 contract.  Per-IP rate limit 3/h (decorator key="phone" is a §V1.5 ask).

post.summary: Verify OTP, mint access JWT, set refresh cookie
post.description: §7.B.2 contract — issues access JWT (body) + refresh cookie (Set-Cookie).

post.summary: Atomically rotate refresh cookie and issue a new access JWT
post.description:
§7.B.3 contract.  On any 401 path the failure handler ALSO clears the cookie.

The 401-path clear-cookie behaviour is implemented via a try/except so
the §7.B.3 "clear cookie on 401" requirement is honoured without relying
on the global error handler (which has no view of this route's
``response`` instance).

§7.B.4 contract.  No rate limit (idempotent, no abuse vector).

Always returns 204 + clear-cookie, regardless of whether a cookie was
present.  The audit row is emitted by the service ONLY when a cookie
was actually present (so calling logout twice does not double-log).

get.description:
§7.B.5 contract.  No rate limit (per-IP DDoS guard is the floor).

No audit event per documented absence — the JWT itself proves the user
is active; logging every ``/me`` would flood the table.

post.summary: Capture a Razorpay webhook (V1: signature-verify + log)
post.description:
§7.B.6 contract.

The body is read as RAW bytes (NOT JSON-parsed at the FastAPI dependency
layer) — Pydantic parsing happens only AFTER HMAC signature verification
succeeds, per the V1 capture-only posture.

get.description:
Liveness probe.  DB / Valkey deep checks are deferred to the
readiness probe wired by the infra lane.

post.summary: Start a Razorpay subscription or LTD purchase
post.description:
Initiate a Razorpay Subscription (recurring) or Order (LTD).

Returns the Razorpay Checkout handle the FE widget needs.  The plan is NOT
granted immediately — it lands via the ``subscription.activated`` /
``payment.captured`` webhook (D-D, Wave 2).

Raises:
    409 ``billing.already_subscribed`` — user already has an active sub.
    502 — Razorpay API unavailable (``RazorpayAdapterError``).

post.summary: Start the 14-day app-side Pro trial (one per phone, no Razorpay call)
post.description:
Grant the 14-day app-side Pro trial (§3.7).

App-side only — NO Razorpay call.  Sets ``users.trial_ends_at = now() + 14
days`` and writes a business ``audit_events`` row.

Raises:
    409 ``billing.trial.already_used`` — trial already used / non-free plan /
        existing subscription (all three are handled as "redundant trial").

post.summary: Cancel the current subscription at end of billing cycle
post.description:
Schedule a cancel-at-cycle-end for the active subscription.

The subscription stays active until ``entitled_until`` (the current
``subscriptions.current_period_end``).  The final ``status → 'cancelled'``
transition is webhook-driven via ``subscription.cancelled`` (Wave 2).

Raises:
    404 ``billing.no_active_subscription`` — no cancellable subscription found.
    502 — Razorpay cancel API unavailable (``RazorpayAdapterError``).

get.summary: Get the current billing / plan / trial status (DB-fresh, F7)
get.description:
Return the DB-fresh billing status for the authenticated seller.

``entitlement`` is the RESOLVED effective tier the FE should gate UI on —
annual→base, ltd→pro, trial→pro while live.  Per founder ruling F7 the plan
is read DB-fresh, not from the JWT claim.

No rate-limit decorator (read-only; per-IP DDoS floor via the middleware).

RefreshResponse.title: RefreshResponse
RefreshResponse.description:
``POST /api/v1/auth/refresh`` 200 body.

Identical SHAPE to :class:`VerifyOtpResponse` but locked as a distinct
model so the OpenAPI surface differentiates them (per §7.E note).

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: MSG91 correlation ID — opaque to the client

VerifyOtpResponse.title: VerifyOtpResponse
VerifyOtpResponse.description:
``POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify`` 200 body.

The refresh token is NOT in the body — it ships in the ``Set-Cookie``
response header per §4.B FE-D5 amendment.

status.title: Status
status.description: Immediate confirmation that a cancel-at-cycle-end was scheduled. The subscription stays active until entitled_until.

entitled_until.title: Entitled Until
entitled_until.description: Current ``subscriptions.current_period_end`` — the seller retains access until this date.  None in edge states (e.g. LTD cancel attempt which is currently blocked).

BillingCancelResponse.title: BillingCancelResponse
BillingCancelResponse.description:
``POST /api/v1/billing/cancel`` 200 body.

The subscription is scheduled to cancel at the end of the current billing
cycle (Razorpay ``cancel_at_cycle_end=True``).  The entitlement remains
active until ``entitled_until``; the actual ``status → 'cancelled'``
transition on ``subscriptions`` is driven by the
``subscription.cancelled`` webhook (Wave 2).

trial_ends_at.title: Trial Ends At
trial_ends_at.description: UTC expiry of the 14-day Pro trial

entitlement.title: Entitlement
entitlement.description: Effective entitlement granted by the trial (always 'pro')

BillingStartTrialResponse.title: BillingStartTrialResponse
BillingStartTrialResponse.description:
``POST /api/v1/billing/start-trial`` 200 body.

The trial grants Pro-level entitlement immediately (app-side — no Razorpay
call).  ``trial_ends_at`` is the absolute UTC expiry; the FE should display
a countdown.  ``entitlement`` is always ``"pro"`` for a live trial.

tier.title: Tier
tier.description: Target billing tier.  Recurring: starter|pro|pro_annual|business|business_annual.  One-time LTD: ltd.

BillingSubscribeRequest.title: BillingSubscribeRequest
BillingSubscribeRequest.description:
``POST /api/v1/billing/subscribe`` request body.

``tier`` drives which Razorpay surface is called:
  - recurring tiers (starter/pro/pro_annual/business/business_annual) →
    Razorpay Subscriptions API (``create_subscription``).
  - ``ltd`` → Razorpay Orders API (``create_order``), one-time payment.
``"free"`` is NOT a subscribable tier — it is the default and can only be
left by subscribing or starting a trial.

BillingSubscribeResponse.title: BillingSubscribeResponse
BillingSubscribeResponse.description:
``POST /api/v1/billing/subscribe`` 201 body.

The actual entitlement grant happens via the Razorpay webhook
(``subscription.activated`` / ``payment.captured``) — this response is
ADVISORY: it only confirms that a checkout session was created.  The FE
MUST wait for the webhook-driven plan update (observable via
``GET /auth/me`` or ``GET /billing/subscription`` polling).

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: users.plan — the raw plan (DB-fresh per F7); may differ from entitlement

status.title: Status
status.description: subscriptions.status (active/cancelled/past_due/…); None if no sub row

current_period_end.title: Current Period End
current_period_end.description: End of the current paid period; None = perpetual (LTD) or no sub

cancel_scheduled.title: Cancel Scheduled
cancel_scheduled.description: True when a cancel-at-cycle-end is pending on the sub row

trial_ends_at.title: Trial Ends At
trial_ends_at.description: The §3.7 14-day trial expiry; None if no trial was started

entitlement.title: Entitlement
entitlement.description: The RESOLVED effective entitlement (the field the FE should gate UI on). Resolves annual→base, ltd→pro, trial→pro while live.

BillingSubscriptionResponse.title: BillingSubscriptionResponse
BillingSubscriptionResponse.description:
``GET /api/v1/billing/subscription`` 200 body.

The DB-fresh subscription/plan/trial status for the authenticated seller.
``entitlement`` is the field the FE should gate UI features on (it is the
RESOLVED effective tier — annual→base, ltd/trial→pro).
